voicemod.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Voicemod right now.

voicemod.selectVoice.description: Switches Voicemod to another voice. Fails with an error when no voice has that name or Voicemod is not connected.

parameters.voice: The voice's name as Voicemod shows it, like "Robot", or its id.

voicemod.selectVoice.returns: The name of the voice that is now on.

voicemod.randomVoice.description: Switches Voicemod to a random voice.

parameters.mode: Optional. Which voices to pick from: "AllVoices", "FreeVoices", "FavoriteVoices" or "CustomVoices". Default "AllVoices".

voicemod.getCurrentVoice.description: Asks Voicemod which voice is on right now.
voicemod.getCurrentVoice.returns: id and name of the current voice.

voicemod.getVoices.returns: A list of voices. Each has id, name and favorite (true when you starred it).

voicemod.getSounds.description: Lists all the sounds on your Voicemod soundboard.
voicemod.getSounds.returns: A list of sounds. Each has name and fileName.

voicemod.playSound.description: Plays a sound from your Voicemod soundboard. Fails with an error when no sound has that name.

parameters.sound: The sound's name as Voicemod shows it, like "Air Horn", or its file name.

voicemod.playSound.returns: The name of the sound that played.

voicemod.stopSounds.description: Stops every Voicemod soundboard sound that is playing.

voicemod.setVoiceChanger.description: Turns the Voicemod voice changer on or off. When it is off, your normal voice is heard.
voicemod.setVoiceChanger.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

voicemod.setHearMyself.description: Turns Voicemod's "Hear myself" on or off. When it is on, you hear your changed voice in your headphones.
voicemod.setHearMyself.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

voicemod.setBackgroundEffects.description: Turns Voicemod's background effects (the sounds behind some voices) on or off.
voicemod.setBackgroundEffects.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

voicemod.setMute.description: Mutes or unmutes your microphone in Voicemod.
voicemod.setMute.returns: The new state: true when muted, false when not.

voicemod.getState.description: Tells you the last known state of one Voicemod switch. It does not ask Voicemod again.
voicemod.getState.returns: true for on, false for off, or null when Cuebot does not know yet. Fails with an error for any other switch name.

voicemod.setCensorBeep.description: Starts or stops Voicemod's censor beep, the bleep that covers bad words.

parameters.state: Optional. "On" starts the beep, "Off" stops it. Default "On".
